sampling.source: vLLM --generation-config auto (default) applies the model's generation_config.json as request defaults

provenance.model_revision: Hugging Face main has not changed since 2024-09-25, before the Modal deployment (reproduce/modal_slm.py, 2026-09-10, which pins no revision), so the cached weights are this commit. Inferred, not read from the server.
provenance.vllm_version: pinned in reproduce/modal_slm.py; slm_smoke.py reads GET /version to confirm
provenance.dtype: modal_slm.py passes no --dtype, so vLLM uses torch_dtype from config.json at this revision
provenance.sampling: values from generation_config.json at this revision (same bytes as main); server-side application not observable from the client
